description:
Seo Woo-young is a poor, obscure artist. One day, an unexpected offer arrives: a letter stating that ‘Gallery B’, the top gallery in South Korea, wants to host an exhibition for his artwork.

Assuming such an absurd offer must be a scam, Woo-young is surprised when Baek Sa-hyeon—the director of the gallery, also known as ‘B’—appears right in front of him.

Sensing Woo-young's desperation, Sa-hyeon tempts him to join in on something wicked.

*“I’m going to sell your paintings. For a very high price.”* *(Source: Bomtoon, translated)*

**Original Novel:**  
Volumes: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/809026341), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/donga0961), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=920023133)  
Chapters: [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/galleryb), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000093644), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/novel/detail.asp?serial_num=se8268)
